subject: Phase 1 excludes production UI changes
decision: Phase 1 scope is product infrastructure only and must not modify production Android UI, Kotlin, or Compose behavior.
reason: Separating infrastructure from product behavior changes keeps delivery risk controlled and preserves existing runtime baselines.
evidence: ROADMAP.md phase definition limits Phase 1 to foundation work.
DECISION_LOG.md confirms no production UI changes in Phase 1.
counterargument: Shipping visible UI changes early could accelerate feedback, but it mixes foundation and feature risk in a single phase.
revisit_condition: Revisit when a later phase is explicitly approved for production UI implementation.
